421: ਜੇਹੀ ਸੇਵ ਕਰਾਈਐ; ਕਰਣੀ ਭੀ ਸਾਈ ॥
As the Lord makes us serve, so do we serve.
ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ. ਕਿਸੁ ਆਖੀਐ; ਵੇਖੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੭॥
He Himself acts; whom else should we tell? He beholds His own greatness. ॥7॥
ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ. ਸੋ ਕਰੇ; ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ॥
He alone serves the Guru, whom the Lord Himself inspires to serve.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਿਰੁ ਦੇ ਛੂਟੀਐ; ਦਰਗਹ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਏ ॥੮॥੧੮॥
O Nanak, offering one's head, one is released, and honoured in the Court of the Lord. ॥8॥18॥
Beautiful and wise is the Lord and Master; beautiful is the Guru's Bani.
ਵਡੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ; ਪਾਈਐ ਪਦੁ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੀ ॥੧॥
By great good fortune, one meets the True Guru, and the state of desirelessness is obtained. ॥1॥
ਮੈ ਓਲੑਗੀਆ ਓਲੑਗੀ; ਹਮ ਛੋਰੂ ਥਾਰੇ ॥
I am the lowliest of Your slaves; I am Your humble servant.
ਜਿਉ ਤੂੰ ਰਾਖਹਿ. ਤਿਉ ਰਹਾ; ਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਮਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
As You keep me, so do I live; Your Name is in my mouth. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਦਰਸਨ ਕੀ ਪਿਆਸਾ ਘਣੀ; ਭਾਣੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਈਐ ॥
I have such a great thirst for the vision of Your Darshan; by Your Will, You are pleasing to my mind.
ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਹਾਥਿ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ; ਭਾਣੈ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੨॥
Greatness is in the hands of my Lord and Master; by His Will, honour is obtained. ॥2॥
ਸਾਚਉ. ਦੂਰਿ ਨ ਜਾਣੀਐ; ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹੈ ਸੋਈ ॥
Do not think the True Lord is far away; He is deep within.
ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਰਵਿ ਰਹੇ; ਕਿਨਿ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਹੋਈ ॥੩॥
Wherever I look, there I find Him pervading; who can estimate His worth? ॥3॥
ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ ਆਪੇ ਹਰੇ; ਵੇਖੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
He Himself creates, and He Himself destroys; He beholds His own glorious greatness.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਹਾਲੀਐ; ਇਉ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੪॥
Becoming Gurmukh, one beholds Him, and thus His worth is known. ॥4॥
ਜੀਵਦਿਆ ਲਾਹਾ ਮਿਲੈ; ਗੁਰ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥
One who works for the Guru earns the profit while yet alive.
ਪੂਰਬਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਲਿਖਿਆ; ਤਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੫॥
If it is so pre-ordained, then one finds the True Guru. ॥5॥
ਮਨਮੁਖ ਤੋਟਾ ਨਿਤ ਹੈ; ਭਰਮਹਿ ਭਰਮਾਏ ॥
The self-willed suffer loss continually, and wander, deluded by doubt.
ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਅੰਧੁ. ਨ ਚੇਤਈ; ਕਿਉ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੬॥
The blind self-willed manmukh does not remember the Lord; how can he obtain the vision of His Darshan? ॥6॥
ਤਾ ਜਗਿ ਆਇਆ ਜਾਣੀਐ; ਸਾਚੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥
One's coming into the world is judged worthwhile only if one is lovingly attuned to the True Lord.
ਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਪਾਰਸੁ ਭਏ; ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥੭॥
Meeting the Guru, one becomes like the philosopher's stone, and one's light merges into the Light. ॥7॥
ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਰਹੈ ਨਿਰਾਲਮੋ; ਕਾਰ ਧੁਰ ਕੀ ਕਰਣੀ ॥
Day and night he remains detached, and does the deeds ordained by the Primal Lord.
ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੰਤੋਖੀਆ; ਰਾਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣੀ ॥੮॥੧੯॥
O Nanak, those who are content with the Name are imbued with the Lord's feet. ॥8॥19॥
ਕੇਤਾ ਆਖਣੁ ਆਖੀਐ; ਤਾ ਕੇ ਅੰਤ. ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
However much I describe Him, I cannot know His limits.
ਮੈ ਨਿਧਰਿਆ, ਧਰ ਏਕ ਤੂੰ; ਮੈ ਤਾਣੁ ਸਤਾਣਾ ॥੧॥
I am without support; You alone are my support, Lord; You are my all-powerful strength. ॥1॥
ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਹੈ; ਸਚ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ॥
This is Nanak's prayer: may I be at peace in the True Name.
ਆਪੁ ਗਇਆ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਈ; ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਮੇਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
When self-conceit is gone and understanding is obtained, one meets the Lord through the Word of the Guru. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Renouncing egotism and pride, one obtains discerning understanding.
ਸਾਹਿਬ ਸਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ; ਦੇ ਸਾਚੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
When the mind is pleased with the Lord and Master, He gives the support of Truth. ॥2॥
ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੰਤੋਖੀਆ; ਸੇਵਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਈ ॥
Day and night, one who is content with the Name — that service is true.
ਤਾ ਕਉ. ਬਿਘਨੁ ਨ ਲਾਗਈ; ਚਾਲੈ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਰਜਾਈ ॥੩॥
No obstacle afflicts one who walks in the Will of the Lord's Command. ॥3॥
ਹੁਕਮਿ ਰਜਾਈ ਜੋ ਚਲੈ; ਸੋ ਪਵੈ ਖਜਾਨੈ ॥
One who walks in the Will of the Lord's Command is placed in His treasury.
ਖੋਟੇ. ਠਵਰ ਨ ਪਾਇਨੀ; ਰਲੇ ਜੂਠਾਨੈ ॥੪॥
The counterfeit find no place there; they are mixed with the false. ॥4॥
ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ. ਖਰਾ ਸਮਾਲੀਐ; ਸਚੁ ਸਉਦਾ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
Cherish forever the Genuine One, and obtain the true merchandise.
ਖੋਟੇ. ਨਦਰਿ ਨ ਆਵਨੀ; ਲੇ ਅਗਨਿ ਜਲਾਈਐ ॥੫॥
The counterfeit are not seen by the Lord; they are put into the fire to be refined. ॥5॥
Those who understand their own soul are themselves the Supreme Soul.
ਏਕੋ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਿਰਖੁ ਹੈ; ਫਲੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੬॥
The One Lord is the ambrosial tree, and its fruit is ambrosial nectar. ॥6॥
ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਫਲੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਚਾਖਿਆ; ਸਚਿ ਰਹੇ ਅਘਾਈ ॥
Those who taste the ambrosial fruit remain satisfied in Truth.
ਤਿੰਨਾ. ਭਰਮੁ ਨ ਭੇਦੁ ਹੈ; ਹਰਿ ਰਸਨ ਰਸਾਈ ॥੭॥
They have no doubt or sense of separation; their tongues taste the essence of the Lord. ॥7॥
ਹੁਕਮਿ ਸੰਜੋਗੀ ਆਇਆ; ਚਲੁ ਸਦਾ ਰਜਾਈ ॥
By His Command, and through your past actions, you have come into the world; walk forever in His Will.
ਅਉਗਣਿਆਰੇ ਕਉ ਗੁਣੁ ਨਾਨਕੈ; ਸਚੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਾਈ ॥੮॥੨੦॥
Bless Nanak, the worthless one, with the virtue of the True Name; this is glorious greatness. ॥8॥20॥
ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਉ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਇ; ਸਚੁ ਵਖਾਣਿਆ ॥
One whose mind is imbued with the Lord's Name speaks the Truth.
ਲੋਕਾ ਦਾ ਕਿਆ ਜਾਇ; ਜਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
What would people lose, if I became pleasing to You, Lord? ॥1॥
422: ਜਉ ਲਗੁ ਜੀਉ ਪਰਾਣ; ਸਚੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
As long as there is the breath of life, meditate on the True Lord.
ਲਾਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ; ਮਿਲੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Singing the glorious praises of the Lord, one obtains the profit, and finds peace. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਸਚੀ ਤੇਰੀ ਕਾਰ; ਦੇਹਿ ਦਇਆਲ ਤੂੰ ॥
True is Your service; please bless me with it, O merciful Lord.
ਹਉ ਜੀਵਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਸਾਲਾਹਿ; ਮੈ ਟੇਕ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਤੂੰ ॥੨॥
I live by praising You; You are my anchor and support. ॥2॥
ਦਰਿ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਦਰਵਾਨੁ; ਦਰਦੁ ਤੂੰ ਜਾਣਹੀ ॥
I am Your servant, the gate-keeper at Your gate; You alone know my pain.
How wonderful is Your devotional worship; it removes all pain. ॥3॥
The Gurmukh knows that, in the Court of the Lord and in His presence, the Name alone is accepted.
True and acceptable is the time of one who recognises the Word. ॥4॥
ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ, ਕਰਿ ਭਾਉ; ਤੋਸਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੇਇ ॥
Those who make truth, contentment and love their provisions take the Name of the Lord.
ਮਨਹੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਵਿਕਾਰ; ਸਚਾ ਸਚੁ ਦੇਇ ॥੫॥
Cast out corruption from your mind, and the True One shall bless you with Truth. ॥5॥
The True Lord inspires true love in the truthful.
ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਨਿਆਉ; ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਇਆ ॥੬॥
He Himself administers justice, as it pleases Him. ॥6॥
ਸਚੇ ਸਚੀ ਦਾਤਿ; ਦੇਹਿ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੈ ॥
True is the gift of the True One; He is merciful, and gives it.
ਤਿਸੁ ਸੇਵੀ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ; ਨਾਮੁ ਅਮੋਲੁ ਹੈ ॥੭॥
Day and night, I serve the One whose Name is priceless. ॥7॥
ਤੂੰ ਉਤਮੁ. ਹਉ ਨੀਚੁ; ਸੇਵਕੁ ਕਾਂਢੀਆ ॥
You are sublime, and I am lowly, yet I am called Your slave.
ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਹੁ; ਮਿਲੈ ਸਚੁ ਵਾਂਢੀਆ ॥੮॥੨੧॥
O Nanak, bless me with Your glance of grace, that I, who am separated from You, may meet the True Lord. ॥8॥21॥
ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ. ਕਿਉ ਰਹੈ; ਕਿਉ. ਮੇਲਾ ਹੋਈ ॥
How can one's coming and going in reincarnation end? How can one meet the Lord?
ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਕਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਘਣੋ; ਨਿਤ ਸਹਸਾ ਦੋਈ ॥੧॥
The pain of birth and death is so great, with constant scepticism and duality. ॥1॥
ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ. ਕਿਆ ਜੀਵਨਾ; ਫਿਟੁ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ॥
Without the Name, what is life? Cursed and accursed is cleverness.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਾਧੁ. ਨ ਸੇਵਿਆ; ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ. ਨ ਭਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
One who does not serve the Holy True Guru does not love devotion to the Lord. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਵਣੁ ਤਉ ਰਹੈ; ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ॥
Coming and going end only when one finds the perfect Guru.
ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਨੁ, ਰਾਸਿ ਦੇਇ; ਬਿਨਸੈ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਕੂਰਾ ॥੨॥
He gives the capital of the wealth of the Lord's Name, and false doubt is destroyed. ॥2॥
ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਉ. ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੈ; ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਏ ॥
One who remains in the company of the humble Saints sings the Lord's praises, giving thanks again and again;
ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਪਰੰਪਰਾ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਏ ॥੩॥
as Gurmukh, he obtains the Lord, the Primal Being, the Infinite. ॥3॥
The world is a game, like the show staged by an actor.
ਖਿਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਬਾਜੀ ਦੇਖੀਐ; ਉਝਰਤ ਨਹੀ ਬਾਰਾ ॥੪॥
For a moment, for an instant, the show is seen, and it is dismantled without delay. ॥4॥
People play the game of chaupar with the pieces of ego, falsehood and pride.
ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਹਾਰੈ, ਸੋ ਜਿਣੈ; ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥੫॥
The whole world loses; he alone wins, who contemplates the Word of the Guru. ॥5॥
ਜਿਉ ਅੰਧੁਲੈ ਹਥਿ ਟੋਹਣੀ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਮਾਰੈ ॥
As a walking stick in the hand of the blind, so is the Lord's Name to me.
ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ, ਟੇਕ ਹੈ; ਨਿਸਿ ਦਉਤ, ਸਵਾਰੈ ॥੬॥
The Lord's Name is my support, night and morning. ॥6॥
ਜਿਉ ਤੂੰ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਤਿਉ ਰਹਾ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥
As You keep me, Lord, so do I live; the Lord's Name is my only support.
ਅੰਤਿ ਸਖਾਈ ਪਾਇਆ; ਜਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਦੁਆਰਾ ॥੭॥
It alone is my companion at the very end; through it, the Lord's humble servant finds the door of liberation. ॥7॥
ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖ ਮੇਟਿਆ; ਜਪਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਰਾਰੇ ॥
The pain of birth and death is erased by chanting the Name of the Lord.
ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ. ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ; ਪੂਰਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਤਾਰੇ ॥੮॥੨੨॥
O Nanak, one who does not forget the Name is carried across by the perfect Guru. ॥8॥22॥

One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਸਾਸਤੁ ਬੇਦੁ ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਰੁ ਤੇਰਾ; ਸੁਰਸਰੀ ਚਰਣ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
The Shastras, Vedas and Simritees are contained in the ocean of Your Name, Lord; the Ganges is contained in Your feet.
ਸਾਖਾ ਤੀਨਿ, ਮੂਲੁ ਮਤਿ ਰਾਵੈ; ਤੂੰ ਤਾਂ ਸਰਬ ਵਿਡਾਣੀ ॥੧॥
The intellect can understand the world of the three branches, but You, O Primal Lord, are utterly wondrous. ॥1॥
ਤਾ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਜਪੈ, ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ; ਬੋਲੇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Servant Nanak meditates on His feet, and chants the Ambrosial Bani of His Word. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਤੇਤੀਸ ਕਰੋੜੀ ਦਾਸ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੇ; ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਅਧਾਰੀ ॥
Three hundred thirty million gods are Your servants; You bestow wealth and supernatural powers, and are the support of the breath of life.
423: ਤਾ ਕੇ ਰੂਪ. ਨ ਜਾਹੀ ਲਖਣੇ; ਕਿਆ ਕਰਿ ਆਖਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
His many forms cannot be described; what can anyone say or contemplate? ॥2॥
ਤੀਨਿ ਗੁਣਾ ਤੇਰੇ, ਜੁਗ ਹੀ ਅੰਤਰਿ; ਚਾਰੇ ਤੇਰੀਆ ਖਾਣੀ ॥
The three qualities within the world are Yours, Lord; the four sources of creation are Yours.
ਕਰਮੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਤਾ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਈਐ; ਕਥੇ ਅਕਥ ਕਹਾਣੀ ॥੩॥
If You show Your mercy, one attains the supreme state, and speaks the unspoken speech. ॥3॥
ਤੂੰ ਕਰਤਾ. ਕੀਆ ਸਭੁ ਤੇਰਾ; ਕਿਆ ਕੋ ਕਰੇ ਪਰਾਣੀ ॥
You are the Creator; all is Your doing; what can any mortal do?
ਜਾ ਕਉ. ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਤੂੰ ਅਪਣੀ; ਸਾਈ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥੪॥
She upon whom You bestow Your glance of grace is absorbed in the True Lord. ॥4॥
ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ. ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ਲੇਤੁ ਹੈ; ਜੇਤੀ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੀ ॥
All who come and go chant Your Name, Lord.
ਜਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ. ਤਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ; ਹੋਰ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਫਿਰੈ ਇਆਣੀ ॥੫॥
When it pleases You, the Gurmukh understands; otherwise, the ignorant self-willed manmukhs wander around. ॥5॥
ਚਾਰੇ ਵੇਦ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੇ ਕਉ ਦੀਏ; ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਕਰੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
The four Vedas were given to Brahma; he read and read them, and reflected upon them.
ਤਾ ਕਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ. ਨ ਬੂਝੈ ਬਪੁੜਾ; ਨਰਕਿ ਸੁਰਗਿ ਅਵਤਾਰੀ ॥੬॥
The poor wretch did not understand the Command of the Lord's Will, and was reincarnated into heaven and hell. ॥6॥
ਜੁਗਹ ਜੁਗਹ ਕੇ ਰਾਜੇ ਕੀਏ; ਗਾਵਹਿ ਕਰਿ ਅਵਤਾਰੀ ॥
In each age, He created the great kings, who are sung of as His incarnations.
ਤਿਨ ਭੀ. ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਤਾ ਕਾ; ਕਿਆ ਕਰਿ ਆਖਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੭॥
Even they have not found His limits; what can I say or contemplate? ॥7॥
ਤੂੰ ਸਚਾ, ਤੇਰਾ ਕੀਆ ਸਭੁ ਸਾਚਾ; ਦੇਹਿ ਤ, ਸਾਚੁ ਵਖਾਣੀ ॥
You are True, and all that You have made is True; if You bless me, I shall speak the Truth.
ਜਾ ਕਉ ਸਚੁ ਬੁਝਾਵਹਿ ਅਪਣਾ; ਸਹਜੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥੮॥੧॥੨੩॥
One whom You inspire to understand Your Truth is intuitively absorbed in the Name. ॥8॥1॥23॥
The True Guru has dispelled my doubt.
He has enshrined the Immaculate Name of the Lord within my mind.
Recognising the Word, I have obtained lasting peace. ॥1॥
Listen to the essence of spiritual wisdom, O my mind.
ਦੇਵਣ ਵਾਲਾ. ਸਭ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਣੈ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The Great Giver knows every way; the treasure of the Name is obtained by becoming Gurmukh. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The glorious greatness of meeting the True Guru
is that the fire of possessiveness and desire has been quenched,
and, imbued with intuitive poise, I sing the glorious praises of the Lord. ॥2॥
ਵਿਣੁ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ; ਕੋਇ ਨ ਜਾਣੀ ॥
Without the perfect Guru, no one knows the Lord.
Attached to Maya, they are lured by duality.
The Gurmukh receives the Name and the Bani of the Lord. ॥3॥
ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ; ਤਪਾਂ ਸਿਰਿ ਤਪੁ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
Service to the Guru is the most sublime of all penances.
ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ; ਸਭ ਦੂਖ ਵਿਸਾਰਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
The Dear Lord dwells in the mind, and all suffering departs.
Then, at the Gate of the True Lord, one appears truthful. ॥4॥
ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ; ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਸੋਝੀ ਹੋਇ ॥
Serving the Guru, one comes to know the Lord who pervades the three worlds.
Understanding his own self, he obtains the Lord.
Through the True Bani, the Mansion of His presence is obtained. ॥5॥
ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ; ਸਭ ਕੁਲ ਉਧਾਰੇ ॥
Serving the Guru, one saves all one's generations.
He keeps the Immaculate Name enshrined within his heart.
At the True Gate, he is adorned with true glory. ॥6॥
ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ; ਜਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਏ ॥
How very fortunate are those whom the Guru commits to His service.
Night and day, He implants within them devotional worship and the True Name.
Through the Name, all their generations are saved. ॥7॥
ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ; ਰਖਹੁ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
keep the Lord's Name enshrined in your heart.
Imbued with devotion to the Lord, one finds the door of salvation. ॥8॥2॥24॥
Everyone lives in hope upon hope.
One who understands His Command becomes free of desire.
So many are asleep in hope.
He alone awakens, whom the Lord awakens. ॥1॥
ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ. ਨਾਮੁ ਬੁਝਾਇਆ; ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ. ਭੁਖ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
The True Guru has led me to understand the Name; without the Name, hunger does not depart.
424: ਨਾਮੇ. ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਬੁਝੈ; ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਿਸੈ ਰਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Through the Name, the fire of desire is extinguished; the Name is obtained by His Will. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, sing His praises, and recognise the Word of the Guru.
This is devotional worship, by which egotism is eliminated.
Serving the True Guru, one becomes acceptable.
ਜਿਨਿ ਆਸਾ ਕੀਤੀ; ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਜਾਨੁ ॥੨॥
So know the One who created hope and desire. ॥2॥
ਤਿਸੁ ਕਿਆ ਦੀਜੈ; ਜਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਾਏ ॥
What shall we offer to the One who proclaims the Word,
and by His grace enshrines the Name within our minds?
Offer your head to Him, and shed your self-conceit.
One who understands His Command finds lasting peace. ॥3॥
He Himself acts, and causes others to act.
He Himself enshrines His Name in the mind of the Gurmukh.
He Himself misleads, and He Himself puts us on the path.
Through the True Word, one merges in the True Lord. ॥4॥
True is the Word, and True is the Bani.
In each and every age, the Gurmukhs speak and chant it.
The self-willed manmukhs are deluded by doubt and attachment.
Without the Name, everyone wanders around insane. ॥5॥
Throughout the three worlds is the One Maya.
ਮੂਰਖਿ ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ; ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ॥
The fool reads and reads, but only reinforces the love of duality.
He performs all sorts of rituals, but still suffers terrible pain.
Serving the True Guru, lasting peace is obtained. ॥6॥
Contemplating the Word, which is so sweet, the ambrosial nectar
is enjoyed day and night, and ego is conquered.
Showering His grace, the Lord blesses one with intuitive poise and bliss.
Imbued with the Name, one embraces love for the True One forever. ॥7॥
Meditate on the Lord, and read about Him, contemplating the Word of the Guru.
Meditate on the Lord, and read about Him, conquering ego.
Meditate on the Lord, imbued with the fear of the True One and with love for Him.
O Nanak, through the Guru's teaching, enshrine the Name in your heart. ॥8॥3॥25॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ਘਰੁ ੮ ਕਾਫੀ ॥
Asa Kafi · Ashtpadis · Guru Amar Das · Ghar 8
ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਊਪਜੈ; ਜਿਨਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
From the Guru comes tranquillity; He has put out the fire of desire.
ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਈਐ; ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੧॥
From the Guru, the Name is obtained; this is the greatest greatness. ॥1॥
Remember the One Name, O my brother.
ਜਗਤੁ ਜਲੰਦਾ ਦੇਖਿ ਕੈ; ਭਜਿ ਪਏ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Seeing the world on fire, I have hurried to the Guru's sanctuary. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਗੁਰ ਤੇ. ਗਿਆਨੁ ਊਪਜੈ; ਮਹਾ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
From the Guru comes spiritual wisdom, and reflection on the supreme reality.
ਗੁਰ ਤੇ. ਘਰੁ ਦਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਭਗਤੀ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
Through the Guru, the Lord's home and gate are found, and the treasures of devotion overflow. ॥2॥
As Gurmukh, one meditates on the Name, and comes to understand this reflection.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਲਾਹ ਹੈ; ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
The Gurmukh obtains devotion and praise, and the Word of the infinite Lord dwells within. ॥3॥
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੂਖੁ ਊਪਜੈ; ਦੁਖੁ. ਕਦੇ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
As Gurmukh, peace wells up, and one never suffers pain.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੀਐ; ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੪॥
As Gurmukh, ego is conquered, and the mind becomes pure. ॥4॥
ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ. ਆਪੁ ਗਇਆ; ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
Meeting the True Guru, self-conceit departs, and one comes to know the Lord of the three worlds.
ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜੋਤਿ ਪਸਰਿ ਰਹੀ; ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥੫॥
The Immaculate Light is pervading everywhere, and one's light merges into the Light. ॥5॥
ਪੂਰੈ ਗੁਰਿ. ਸਮਝਾਇਆ; ਮਤਿ ਊਤਮ ਹੋਈ ॥
When the perfect Guru instructs, the intellect becomes sublime.
ਅੰਤਰੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਹੋਇ; ਨਾਮੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੬॥
Within, one is cooled and soothed, and through the Name, peace is obtained. ॥6॥
ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਤਾਂ ਮਿਲੈ; ਜਾਂ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਈ ॥
One meets the perfect True Guru only when the Lord bestows His glance of grace.
ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਪਾਪ ਸਭ ਕਟੀਅਹਿ; ਫਿਰਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਬਿਘਨੁ. ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੭॥
All sins and evil deeds are cut away, and one never again suffers pain or obstacles. ॥7॥
425: ਆਪਣੈ ਹਥਿ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ; ਦੇ ਨਾਮੇ ਲਾਏ ॥
Glorious greatness is in His own hands; He bestows it, and attaches us to the Name.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ, ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ; ਵਡਿਆਈ ਪਾਏ ॥੮॥੪॥੨੬॥
O Nanak, one in whose mind the treasure of the Name abides obtains glorious greatness. ॥8॥4॥26॥
ਸੁਣਿ ਮਨ, ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇ ਤੂੰ; ਆਪੇ ਆਇ ਮਿਲੈ. ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
Listen, O mind, and enshrine the Name within; He shall come to meet you, O my brother.
ਅਨਦਿਨੁ, ਸਚੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਿ; ਸਚੈ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਈ ॥੧॥
Night and day, practise true devotion, and focus your consciousness on the True Lord. ॥1॥
ਏਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਤੂੰ; ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ. ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
Meditate on the One Name, and you shall find peace, O my brother.
ਹਉਮੈ ਦੂਜਾ ਦੂਰਿ ਕਰਿ; ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Eradicate egotism and duality, and your glory shall be great. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਇਸੁ ਭਗਤੀ ਨੋ. ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਲੋਚਦੇ; ਵਿਣੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ. ਪਾਈ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
The angels, mortals and silent sages long for this devotional worship, but without the True Guru it cannot be obtained.
ਪੰਡਿਤ ਪੜਦੇ ਜੋਤਿਕੀ; ਤਿਨ ਬੂਝ. ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥੨॥
The Pandits and the astrologers read their books, but they do not understand. ॥2॥
ਆਪੈ ਥੈ ਸਭੁ ਰਖਿਓਨੁ; ਕਿਛੁ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
He keeps everything in His own hands; nothing can be said about it.
ਆਪੇ ਦੇਇ. ਸੁ ਪਾਈਐ; ਗੁਰਿ. ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੩॥
Whatever He gives, we receive; the Guru has given me this understanding. ॥3॥
ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਤਿਸ ਦੇ; ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਸੋਈ ॥
All beings and creatures are His; He belongs to all.
ਮੰਦਾ ਕਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਖੀਐ; ਜੇ ਦੂਜਾ ਹੋਈ ॥੪॥
Whom can we call bad, when there is no other? ॥4॥
ਇਕੋ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ; ਏਕਾ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਾਰਾ ॥
The Command of the One Lord prevails; each must do the work written on his forehead.
ਆਪਿ ਭਵਾਲੀ ਦਿਤੀਅਨੁ; ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲੋਭੁ ਵਿਕਾਰਾ ॥੫॥
Those whom He Himself sets wandering have greed and corruption within. ॥5॥
ਇਕ ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕੀਤਿਅਨੁ; ਬੂਝਨਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
He Himself makes some Gurmukh, and they understand and reflect.
ਭਗਤਿ ਭੀ ਓਨਾ ਨੋ ਬਖਸੀਅਨੁ; ਅੰਤਰਿ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥੬॥
He blesses them with devotional worship, and within them are His treasures. ॥6॥
ਗਿਆਨੀਆ ਨੋ ਸਭੁ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ; ਸਚੁ ਸੋਝੀ ਹੋਈ ॥
To the spiritually wise, all is truth; they have the understanding of Truth.
ਓਇ ਭੁਲਾਏ. ਕਿਸੈ ਦੇ, ਨ ਭੁਲਨੑੀ; ਸਚੁ ਜਾਣਨਿ ਸੋਈ ॥੭॥
They cannot be led astray, though others may try to mislead them; they know the True Lord. ॥7॥
ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਪੰਚ ਵਰਤਦੇ; ਪੰਚੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
The five passions abide within the home of the body, but in them, the five behave with discernment.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ, ਵਸਿ ਨ ਆਵਨੑੀ; ਨਾਮਿ. ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੀ ॥੮॥੫॥੨੭॥
O Nanak, without the True Guru, they are not controlled; through the Name, ego is conquered. ॥8॥5॥27॥
ਘਰੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ. ਸਭੁ ਵਥੁ ਹੈ; ਬਾਹਰਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
Everything is within the home of the self; there is nothing beyond.
ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਪਾਈਐ; ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕਪਟ ਖੁਲਾਹੀ ॥੧॥
By the Guru's grace, it is obtained, and the doors of the heart are opened wide. ॥1॥
From the True Guru, the Lord's Name is obtained, O brother.
ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ; ਪੂਰੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਦਿਖਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The treasure of the Name is within; the perfect True Guru has shown it to me. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਗਾਹਕੁ ਹੋਵੈ. ਸੋ ਲਏ; ਪਾਏ ਰਤਨੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
One who is a buyer of the Lord's Name finds it, and obtains the jewel of contemplation.
ਅੰਦਰੁ ਖੋਲੈ ਦਿਬ ਦਿਸਟਿ; ਦੇਖੈ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
He opens the doors deep within, and through the eyes of divine vision beholds the treasure of liberation. ॥2॥
ਅੰਦਰਿ ਮਹਲ ਅਨੇਕ ਹਹਿ; ਜੀਉ ਕਰੇ ਵਸੇਰਾ ॥
There are so many mansions within the body; the soul dwells within them.
ਮਨ ਚਿੰਦਿਆ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਸੀ; ਫਿਰਿ. ਹੋਇ ਨ ਫੇਰਾ ॥੩॥
He obtains the fruit of his mind's desires, and he shall not be reincarnated again. ॥3॥
ਪਾਰਖੀਆ. ਵਥੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ਲਈ; ਗੁਰ. ਸੋਝੀ ਹੋਈ ॥
The appraisers cherish the merchandise of the Name; they obtain understanding from the Guru.
ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਅਮੁਲੁ ਸਾ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਕੋਈ ॥੪॥
The wealth of the Name is priceless; how few are the Gurmukhs who obtain it! ॥4॥
ਬਾਹਰੁ ਭਾਲੇ, ਸੁ ਕਿਆ ਲਹੈ; ਵਥੁ ਘਰੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਭਾਈ ॥
Searching outside, what can anyone find? The merchandise is deep within the home of the self, O brother.
ਭਰਮੇ ਭੂਲਾ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਫਿਰੈ; ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਪਤਿ ਗਵਾਈ ॥੫॥
The whole world wanders around, deluded by doubt; the self-willed manmukh loses his honour. ॥5॥
ਘਰੁ ਦਰੁ ਛੋਡੇ ਆਪਣਾ; ਪਰ ਘਰਿ ਝੂਠਾ ਜਾਈ ॥
The false one leaves his own hearth and home, and goes to another's home.
ਚੋਰੈ ਵਾਂਗੂ ਪਕੜੀਐ; ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ. ਚੋਟਾ ਖਾਈ ॥੬॥
Like a thief, he is caught, and without the Name, he is beaten and struck down. ॥6॥
ਜਿਨੑੀ ਘਰੁ ਜਾਤਾ ਆਪਣਾ; ਸੇ ਸੁਖੀਏ ਭਾਈ ॥
Those who know their own home are happy, O brother.
ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ; ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੭॥
They realise God within their own hearts, through the glorious greatness of the Guru. ॥7॥
ਆਪੇ ਦਾਨੁ ਕਰੇ. ਕਿਸੁ ਆਖੀਐ; ਆਪੇ ਦੇਇ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
He Himself gives gifts; whom else should we tell? He Himself grants understanding.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਤੂੰ; ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਈ ॥੮॥੬॥੨੮॥
O Nanak, meditate on the Name, and you shall obtain glory at the True Gate. ॥8॥6॥28॥
426: ਆਪੈ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ; ਸਾਦੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਭਾਈ ॥
One who understands his own self tastes the sweet essence, O brother.
ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਚਾਖਿਐ. ਮੁਕਤੁ ਭਏ; ਜਿਨੑਾ ਸਾਚੋ ਭਾਈ ॥੧॥
Those who love the True Lord are liberated, tasting the sublime essence of the Lord. ॥1॥
ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ. ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ; ਨਿਰਮਲ ਮਨਿ ਵਾਸਾ ॥
The Dear Lord is the purest of the pure; He dwells within the pure mind.
ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ; ਬਿਖਿਆ ਮਾਹਿ ਉਦਾਸਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Praising Him through the Guru's teaching, one remains detached in the midst of corruption. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ. ਆਪੁ ਨ ਜਾਪਈ; ਸਭ ਅੰਧੀ ਭਾਈ ॥
Without the Word, one does not understand one's own self; the whole world is blind, O brother.
ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਘਟਿ ਚਾਨਣਾ; ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਤਿ ਸਖਾਈ ॥੨॥
Through the Guru's teaching, the heart is illumined, and the Name is our companion at the very end. ॥2॥
ਨਾਮੇ ਹੀ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਰਤਦੇ; ਨਾਮੇ ਵਰਤਾਰਾ ॥
They are absorbed in the Name, and deal only in the Name.
ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ, ਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ; ਨਾਮੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
The Name is within them, the Name is on their lips; through the Word, they contemplate the Name. ॥3॥
ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਣੀਐ. ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨੀਐ; ਨਾਮੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
Hear the Name, believe in the Name; through the Name, glorious greatness is obtained.
ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹੇ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ; ਨਾਮੇ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਈ ॥੪॥
One who praises the Name forever obtains, through the Name, the Mansion of the Lord's presence. ॥4॥
ਨਾਮੇ ਹੀ ਘਟਿ ਚਾਨਣਾ; ਨਾਮੇ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਈ ॥
Through the Name, the heart is illumined; through the Name, glory is obtained.
ਨਾਮੇ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਊਪਜੈ; ਨਾਮੇ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੫॥
Through the Name, peace wells up; I seek the sanctuary of the Name. ॥5॥
ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ. ਕੋਇ ਨ ਮੰਨੀਐ; ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਪਤਿ ਗਵਾਈ ॥
Without the Name, no one is accepted; the self-willed manmukh loses his honour.
ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਬਾਧੇ ਮਾਰੀਅਹਿ; ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਈ ॥੬॥
Bound and gagged in the city of death, he is beaten, and wastes his life in vain. ॥6॥
ਨਾਮੈ ਕੀ ਸਭ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੈ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
Everyone serves the one who chants the Name; the Guru gives the understanding of the Name.
ਨਾਮਹੁ ਹੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨੀਐ; ਨਾਮੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੭॥
Through the Name, one is honoured; in the Name is glorious greatness. ॥7॥
ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਦੇਵੈ. ਤਿਸੁ ਮਿਲੈ; ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
He alone receives it, to whom it is given; through the Guru's teaching, He grants understanding of the Name.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ ਹੈ; ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ. ਕੋ ਪਾਈ ॥੮॥੭॥੨੯॥
O Nanak, everything is under the control of the Name; by perfect destiny, a few obtain it. ॥8॥7॥29॥
ਦੋਹਾਗਣੀ. ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਨੑੀ; ਨ ਜਾਣਨਿ. ਪਿਰ ਕਾ ਸੁਆਉ ॥
The unfortunate soul-brides do not obtain the Mansion of their Husband Lord's presence, nor do they know His taste.
ਫਿਕਾ ਬੋਲਹਿ. ਨਾ ਨਿਵਹਿ; ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਸੁਆਉ ॥੧॥
They speak harsh words, and do not bow to Him; they are in love with another. ॥1॥
ਇਹੁ ਮਨੂਆ; ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਵਸਿ ਆਵੈ ॥
How can this mind be brought under control?
ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਠਾਕੀਐ; ਗਿਆਨ ਮਤੀ ਘਰਿ ਆਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
By the Guru's grace, it is held in check; with the understanding of spiritual wisdom, it returns home. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਆਪਿ ਸਵਾਰੀਓਨੁ; ਲਾਇ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
He Himself adorns the happy soul-brides, inspiring them with love and affection.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਚਲਦੀਆ; ਨਾਮੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
They walk in harmony with the Will of the True Guru, adorned intuitively with the Name. ॥2॥
ਸਦਾ ਰਾਵਹਿ ਪਿਰੁ ਆਪਣਾ; ਸਚੀ ਸੇਜ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
They enjoy their Beloved forever, and their bed is adorned with Truth and love.
ਪਿਰ ਕੈ ਪ੍ਰੇਮਿ ਮੋਹੀਆ; ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇ ॥੩॥
Fascinated by the love of their Husband Lord, they meet their Beloved and obtain peace. ॥3॥
ਗਿਆਨ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਹੈ; ਸੋਭਾਵੰਤੀ ਨਾਰਿ ॥
Spiritual wisdom is the incomparable decoration of the glorious soul-bride.
ਸਾ ਸਭਰਾਈ ਸੁੰਦਰੀ; ਪਿਰ ਕੈ ਹੇਤਿ. ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥੪॥
She becomes beautiful, a queen, through the love and affection of her Husband Lord. ॥4॥
ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਵਿਚਿ. ਰੰਗੁ ਰਖਿਓਨੁ; ਸਚੈ ਅਲਖਿ ਅਪਾਰਿ ॥
The True, unseen, infinite Lord has kept His love within the happy soul-brides.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਆਪਣਾ; ਸਚੈ ਭਾਇ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥੫॥
They serve their True Guru with true love and affection. ॥5॥
ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਬਣਾਇਆ; ਗੁਣ ਕਾ ਗਲਿ ਹਾਰੁ ॥
The happy soul-bride has adorned herself with the necklace of virtue.
ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਿਰਮਲੁ. ਤਨਿ ਲਾਵਣਾ; ਅੰਤਰਿ. ਰਤਨੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥੬॥
She applies the perfume of love to her body, and within her mind is the jewel of reflection. ॥6॥
ਭਗਤਿ ਰਤੇ. ਸੇ ਊਤਮਾ; ਜਤਿ ਪਤਿ ਸਬਦੇ ਹੋਇ ॥
Those who are imbued with devotional worship are the most exalted; their social status and honour come from the Word.
ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ. ਸਭ ਨੀਚ ਜਾਤਿ ਹੈ; ਬਿਸਟਾ ਕਾ ਕੀੜਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੭॥
Without the Name, all are of low status, like maggots in manure. ॥7॥
ਹਉ ਹਉ ਕਰਦੀ ਸਭ ਫਿਰੈ; ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ. ਹਉ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
Everyone goes around proclaiming "I, I", but without the Word, ego does not depart.
ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ. ਤਿਨ ਹਉਮੈ ਗਈ; ਸਚੈ ਰਹੇ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੮॥੮॥੩੦॥
O Nanak, those who are imbued with the Name lose their ego, and remain absorbed in the True Lord. ॥8॥8॥30॥
ਸਚੇ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਨਿਰਮਲੇ; ਸਦਾ ਸਚੀ ਸੋਇ ॥
Those who are imbued with the True Lord are immaculate; their reputation is forever true.
ਐਥੈ ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਪਦੇ; ਆਗੈ ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
Here, they are known in each and every home, and hereafter, they are famous throughout the ages. ॥1॥
427: ਏ ਮਨ. ਰੂੜੑੇ ਰੰਗੁਲੇ; ਤੂੰ ਸਚਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਚੜਾਇ ॥
O beautiful, joyful mind, dye yourself in the true colour.
ਰੂੜੀ ਬਾਣੀ. ਜੇ ਰਪੈ; ਨਾ ਇਹੁ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਹੈ, ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
If you are dyed in the beautiful Bani of the Word, this colour shall never fade or depart. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਹਮ ਨੀਚ ਮੈਲੇ. ਅਤਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੀ; ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥
I am lowly, filthy and utterly proud, attached to the corruption of duality.
ਗੁਰਿ ਪਾਰਸਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ. ਕੰਚਨੁ ਹੋਏ; ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜੋਤਿ ਅਪਾਰ ॥੨॥
Meeting the Guru, the philosopher's stone, I am transformed into gold, blended with the pure Light of the infinite Lord. ॥2॥
ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ. ਕੋਇ ਨ ਰੰਗੀਐ; ਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ. ਰੰਗੁ ਚੜਾਉ ॥
Without the Guru, no one is dyed in the Lord's love; meeting the Guru, this colour is applied.
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭੈ ਭਾਇ. ਜੋ ਰਤੇ; ਸਿਫਤੀ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਉ ॥੩॥
Those who are imbued with the fear and love of the Guru are absorbed in the praise of the True Lord. ॥3॥
ਭੈ ਬਿਨੁ. ਲਾਗਿ ਨ ਲਗਈ; ਨਾ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Without fear, the cloth of the mind cannot be dyed, nor can the mind be made pure.
ਬਿਨੁ ਭੈ. ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਣੇ; ਝੂਠੇ. ਠਾਉ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੪॥
Without fear, the performance of rituals is false, and one finds no place of rest. ॥4॥
ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਪੇ ਰੰਗੇ. ਸੁ ਰਪਸੀ; ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
He alone is dyed, whom the Lord Himself dyes, uniting him with the True Congregation.
ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਊਪਜੈ; ਸਹਜੇ ਸਚਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥੫॥
From the perfect Guru, the True Congregation is obtained, and one is absorbed in the True One with intuitive ease and love. ॥5॥
ਬਿਨੁ ਸੰਗਤੀ. ਸਭਿ ਐਸੇ ਰਹਹਿ; ਜੈਸੇ ਪਸੁ ਢੋਰ ॥
Without the Congregation, all remain like beasts and cattle.
ਜਿਨੑਿ ਕੀਤੇ. ਤਿਸੈ, ਨ ਜਾਣਨੑੀ; ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ. ਸਭਿ ਚੋਰ ॥੬॥
They do not know the One who created them; without the Name, all are thieves. ॥6॥
ਇਕਿ ਗੁਣ ਵਿਹਾਝਹਿ, ਅਉਗਣ ਵਿਕਣਹਿ; ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
Some purchase virtue, and sell off their faults, through the intuitive peace and love of the Guru.
ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ. ਨਾਉ ਪਾਇਆ; ਵੁਠਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਆਇ ॥੭॥
Serving the Guru, they obtain the Name, and the Lord comes to dwell within them. ॥7॥
ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ; ਸਿਰਿ ਧੰਧੈ ਲਾਇ ॥
The One Lord is the Giver of all; He assigns tasks to each and every person.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮੇ ਲਾਇ ਸਵਾਰਿਅਨੁ; ਸਬਦੇ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੮॥੯॥੩੧॥
O Nanak, He has embellished them by attaching them to the Name; through the Word, He unites them with Himself. ॥8॥9॥31॥
ਸਭ ਨਾਵੈ ਨੋ ਲੋਚਦੀ; ਜਿਸੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ॥
Everyone longs for the Name, but he alone receives it, upon whom the Lord shows mercy.
ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ. ਸਭੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਹੈ; ਸੁਖੁ ਤਿਸੁ. ਜਿਸੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥੧॥
Without the Name, there is only pain; he alone finds peace, in whose mind the Lord enshrines it. ॥1॥
ਤੂੰ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੈ; ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥
You are infinite and merciful, O Lord; I have come to Your sanctuary.
ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਤੇ ਪਾਈਐ; ਨਾਮੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
From the perfect Guru, Your Name is obtained; through the Name comes glory. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ; ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਉਪਾਈ ॥
Within and without, there is the One Lord; He has created the world in so many ways.
ਹੁਕਮੇ. ਕਾਰ ਕਰਾਇਦਾ; ਦੂਜਾ. ਕਿਸੁ ਕਹੀਐ ਭਾਈ ॥੨॥
By His Command, He makes all do their work; whom else can we name, O brother? ॥2॥
ਬੁਝਣਾ ਅਬੁਝਣਾ, ਤੁਧੁ ਕੀਆ; ਇਹ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਾਰ ॥
Understanding and lack of understanding are Your making, Lord; the task on each one's head is set by You.
ਇਕਨੑਾ ਬਖਸਿਹਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਲੈਹਿ; ਇਕਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਾਰਿ ਕਢੇ ਕੂੜਿਆਰ ॥੩॥
Some You forgive and unite with Yourself; others, the false ones, are struck down and driven out of Your court. ॥3॥
ਇਕਿ. ਧੁਰਿ ਪਵਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਹਹਿ; ਤੁਧੁ ਨਾਮੇ ਲਾਏ ॥
Some are pure and sanctified from the very beginning; You have attached them to Your Name.
ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ. ਸੁਖੁ ਊਪਜੈ; ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ॥੪॥
Serving the Guru, peace wells up; through the True Word, He grants understanding. ॥4॥
ਇਕਿ ਕੁਚਲ ਕੁਚੀਲ, ਵਿਖਲੀ ਪਤੇ; ਨਾਵਹੁ ਆਪਿ ਖੁਆਏ ॥
Some are crooked, filthy and wicked; the Lord Himself has led them away from the Name.
ਨਾ ਓਨ ਸਿਧਿ. ਨ ਬੁਧਿ ਹੈ, ਨ ਸੰਜਮੀ; ਫਿਰਹਿ ਉਤਵਤਾਏ ॥੫॥
They have no success in life, no wisdom and no self-discipline; they wander around, wavering. ॥5॥
ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਣੀ; ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਭਾਵਨੀ ਲਾਏ ॥
One upon whom He casts His glance of grace, He blesses with faith in the Name.
ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਇਹ ਸੰਜਮੀ; ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਾਏ ॥੬॥
Truth, contentment and self-discipline come to him, as the Lord lets him hear the pure Word. ॥6॥
ਲੇਖਾ ਪੜਿ. ਨ ਪਹੂਚੀਐ; ਕਥਿ ਕਹਣੈ. ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
By reading accounts, His limit cannot be reached; by speaking and describing, His end cannot be found.
ਗੁਰ ਤੇ. ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ; ਸਚਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਇ ॥੭॥
Through the Guru, His worth is known; through the True Word, understanding is obtained. ॥7॥
ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਦੇਹੀ ਸੋਧਿ ਤੂੰ; ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
Search this mind and body of yours, reflecting on the Word of the Guru.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਇਸੁ ਦੇਹੀ ਵਿਚਿ, ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ; ਪਾਈਐ. ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਹੇਤਿ, ਅਪਾਰਿ ॥੮॥੧੦॥੩੨॥
O Nanak, within this body is the treasure of the Name; it is obtained through the infinite love of the Guru. ॥8॥10॥32॥
ਸਚਿ ਰਤੀਆ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ; ਜਿਨਾ. ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੀਗਾਰਿ ॥
The happy soul-brides who adorn themselves with the Word of the Guru are imbued with Truth;
428: ਘਰ ਹੀ. ਸੋ ਪਿਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
within their own home they have found their Husband Lord, reflecting on the True Word. ॥1॥
ਅਵਗਣ. ਗੁਣੀ ਬਖਸਾਇਆ; ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥
She who attunes herself to the Lord has her faults forgiven through her virtues.
ਹਰਿ ਵਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਕਾਮਣੀ; ਗੁਰਿ. ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
That soul-bride obtains the Lord as her Husband; the Guru unites her in union with Him. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਇਕਿ. ਪਿਰੁ ਹਦੂਰਿ. ਨ ਜਾਣਨੑੀ; ਦੂਜੈ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇ ॥
Some do not know their Husband Lord is ever-present; deluded by duality and doubt, they go astray.
ਕਿਉ ਪਾਇਨੑਿ ਡੋਹਾਗਣੀ; ਦੁਖੀ ਰੈਣਿ ਵਿਹਾਇ ॥੨॥
How can the unfortunate soul-brides meet Him? Their life-night passes in pain. ॥2॥
ਜਿਨ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ. ਸਚੁ ਵਸਿਆ; ਸਚੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
Those in whose minds the True Lord abides practise true deeds.
ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ. ਸਹਜ ਸਿਉ; ਸਚੇ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੩॥
Night and day, they serve Him with intuitive poise, and are absorbed in the True One. ॥3॥
ਦੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਈਆ; ਕੂੜੁ ਬੋਲਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਹਿ ॥
The unfortunate soul-brides are deluded by doubt; speaking falsehood, they eat poison.
ਪਿਰੁ. ਨ ਜਾਣਨਿ ਆਪਣਾ; ਸੁੰਞੀ ਸੇਜ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਹਿ ॥੪॥
They do not know their Husband Lord; on their empty bed, they suffer pain. ॥4॥
ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ; ਮਤੁ ਮਨ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਹਿ ॥
The True Master is One alone; O mind, do not be deluded by doubt.
ਗੁਰ ਪੂਛਿ. ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਹਿ; ਸਚੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਹਿ ॥੫॥
Ask the Guru and serve Him, and you shall enshrine the pure True Lord within your mind. ॥5॥
ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਸਦਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਹਉਮੈ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
The happy soul-bride, shedding her ego and self-conceit, finds her Husband Lord forever.
ਪਿਰ ਸੇਤੀ. ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਗਹਿ ਰਹੀ; ਸਚੀ ਸੇਜ. ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇ ॥੬॥
Night and day, she clings to her Husband Lord; on her true bed, she finds peace. ॥6॥
ਮੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਰਿ ਗਏ; ਪਲੈ. ਕਿਛੁ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
Those who departed crying "Mine, mine!" gained nothing at all.
ਮਹਲੁ ਨਾਹੀ. ਡੋਹਾਗਣੀ; ਅੰਤਿ ਗਈ ਪਛੁਤਾਇ ॥੭॥
The unfortunate soul-bride does not find the Mansion of His presence, and departs in regret at the end. ॥7॥
ਸੋ ਪਿਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ; ਏਕਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
That Husband Lord of mine is the One alone; attune yourself to the One.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਜੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਲੋੜਹਿ ਕਾਮਣੀ; ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇ ॥੮॥੧੧॥੩੩॥
O Nanak, if you long for peace, O soul-bride, enshrine the Lord's Name in your mind. ॥8॥11॥33॥
ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ. ਜਿਨੑਾ ਚਖਾਇਓਨੁ; ਰਸੁ ਆਇਆ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
Those whom the Lord lets taste the ambrosial nectar enjoy its flavour with intuitive ease and love.
ਸਚਾ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ਹੈ; ਤਿਸ ਨੋ. ਤਿਲੁ ਨ ਤਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
The True Lord is carefree; He has not even a trace of greed. ॥1॥
ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸਚਾ ਵਰਸਦਾ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
The true ambrosial nectar rains down; it falls into the mouths of the Gurmukhs.
ਮਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਹਰੀਆਵਲਾ; ਸਹਜੇ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Their minds are forever rejuvenated, as they sing the Lord's praises with intuitive ease. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਦੋਹਾਗਣੀ; ਦਰਿ ਖੜੀਆ ਬਿਲਲਾਹਿ ॥
The self-willed manmukhs are forever unfortunate soul-brides; they stand at His door, wailing.
ਜਿਨੑਾ. ਪਿਰ ਕਾ ਸੁਆਦੁ. ਨ ਆਇਓ; ਜੋ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੋੁ ਕਮਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
Those who have not tasted the joy of their Husband Lord act according to what was written for them from the beginning. ॥2॥
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੀਜੇ. ਸਚੁ ਜਮੈ; ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਾਪਾਰੁ ॥
The Gurmukh plants the seed of the True Name, and it sprouts; he deals in the True Name.
ਜੋ ਇਤੁ ਲਾਹੈ ਲਾਇਅਨੁ; ਭਗਤੀ ਦੇਇ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥੩॥
Those whom the Lord has attached to this profitable trade, He blesses with the treasure of devotion. ॥3॥
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ; ਭੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਸੀਗਾਰਿ ॥
The Gurmukh is forever a happy soul-bride, adorned with the fear of God and devotion.
ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਵਹਿ ਪਿਰੁ ਆਪਣਾ; ਸਚੁ ਰਖਹਿ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੪॥
Night and day, she enjoys her Husband Lord, keeping the True One enshrined in her heart. ॥4॥
ਜਿਨੑਾ. ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵਿਆ ਆਪਣਾ; ਤਿਨੑਾ ਵਿਟਹੁ. ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
I am a sacrifice to those who have enjoyed their Husband Lord.
ਸਦਾ ਪਿਰ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਹਹਿ; ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥੫॥
They remain with their Husband Lord forever, having shed their self-conceit from within. ॥5॥
ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ. ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ; ਪਿਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਇ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
Their body and mind are cooled and soothed, and their faces radiant, through the love and affection of their Husband Lord.
ਸੇਜ ਸੁਖਾਲੀ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਵੈ; ਹਉਮੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਮਾਰਿ ॥੬॥
Their bed is comfortable, and their Husband Lord enjoys them, as they conquer ego and desire. ॥6॥
ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ. ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ; ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਹੇਤਿ ਅਪਾਰਿ ॥
Showering His mercy, He comes into the home of the heart, through the infinite love of the Guru.
ਵਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ; ਕੇਵਲ ਏਕੁ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥੭॥
The happy soul-bride obtains the One Lord alone as her Husband. ॥7॥
ਸਭੇ ਗੁਨਹ. ਬਖਸਾਇ ਲਇਓਨੁ; ਮੇਲੇ ਮੇਲਣਹਾਰਿ ॥
All her sins are forgiven; the Uniter unites her with Himself.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਆਖਣੁ ਆਖੀਐ; ਜੇ ਸੁਣਿ ਧਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥੮॥੧੨॥੩੪॥
O Nanak, speak such speech that, hearing it, He embraces love for you. ॥8॥12॥34॥
ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ. ਗੁਣ ਊਪਜੈ; ਜਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਲੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
From the True Guru, virtue wells up, when God unites one with Him.
429: ਸਹਜੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ; ਗਿਆਨੁ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
With intuitive ease, one meditates on the Name, and spiritual wisdom is revealed. ॥1॥
ਏ ਮਨ. ਮਤ ਜਾਣਹਿ. ਹਰਿ ਦੂਰਿ ਹੈ; ਸਦਾ ਵੇਖੁ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥
O my mind, do not think that the Lord is far away; behold Him ever close at hand.
ਸਦ ਸੁਣਦਾ. ਸਦ ਵੇਖਦਾ; ਸਬਦਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
He is always listening, always watching; through the Word, He is seen to be pervading everywhere. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ; ਤਿਨੑੀ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
The Gurmukhs recognise their own selves; they meditate on the Lord with one-pointed mind.
ਸਦਾ ਰਵਹਿ ਪਿਰੁ ਆਪਣਾ; ਸਚੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
They enjoy their Husband Lord forever; through the True Name, they find peace. ॥2॥
ਏ ਮਨ. ਤੇਰਾ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ; ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
O mind, no one belongs to you; reflect on the Word, and see.
ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਭਜਿ ਪਉ; ਪਾਇਹਿ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥੩॥
Run to the sanctuary of the Lord, and you shall find the door of liberation. ॥3॥
ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਣੀਐ. ਸਬਦਿ ਬੁਝੀਐ; ਸਚਿ ਰਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
Through the Word, the Name is heard; through the Word, it is understood; through it, one remains attuned to the True One.
ਸਬਦੇ. ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੀਐ; ਸਚੈ ਮਹਲਿ. ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇ ॥੪॥
Through the Word, ego is conquered; in the True Mansion, one finds peace. ॥4॥
ਇਸੁ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ. ਸੋਭਾ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ; ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ. ਸੋਭ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
In this age, glory comes from the Name; without the Name, there is no glory.
ਇਹ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ. ਚਾਰਿ ਦਿਹਾੜੇ; ਜਾਦੀ. ਬਿਲਮੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੫॥
The glory of Maya lasts only a few days; it departs without delay. ॥5॥
ਜਿਨੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ; ਸੇ ਮੁਏ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
Those who forget the Name are already dead, and they keep on dying.
ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਸਾਦੁ. ਨ ਆਇਓ; ਬਿਸਟਾ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥੬॥
They do not enjoy the taste of the Lord's sublime essence; they sink into the manure of vice. ॥6॥
ਇਕਿ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਅਨੁ; ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੇ ਲਾਇ ॥
Some the Lord Himself forgives and unites with Himself, attaching them to the Name night and day.
ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਸਚਿ ਰਹਹਿ; ਸਚੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥੭॥
They practise Truth and abide in Truth; they are absorbed in the Truest of the True. ॥7॥
ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ. ਸੁਣੀਐ ਨ ਦੇਖੀਐ; ਜਗੁ ਬੋਲਾ. ਅੰਨੑਾ ਭਰਮਾਇ ॥
Without the Word, nothing is heard and nothing is seen; the world, deaf and blind, wanders around.
ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ. ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਸੀ; ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਿਸੈ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੮॥
Without the Name, it suffers pain; the Name is received only by His Will. ॥8॥
ਜਿਨ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ; ਸੇ ਜਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
Those who link their consciousness with the Bani are pure, and accepted by the Lord.
ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਤਿਨੑਾ. ਕਦੇ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ; ਸੇ ਦਰਿ ਸਚੇ ਜਾਣੁ ॥੯॥੧੩॥੩੫॥
O Nanak, they never forget the Name; they are known at the True Gate. ॥9॥13॥35॥
ਸਬਦੌ ਹੀ ਭਗਤ ਜਾਪਦੇ; ਜਿਨੑ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਚੀ ਹੋਇ ॥
Through the Word, the devotees become known; their speech is true.
ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਇਆ. ਨਾਉ ਮੰਨਿਆ; ਸਚਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
Self-conceit departs from within, they accept the Name, and they meet with the True One. ॥1॥
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ; ਜਨ ਕੀ ਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is the honour of His humble servants.
ਸਫਲੁ ਤਿਨੑਾ ਕਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਹੈ; ਤਿਨੑ ਮਾਨੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Fruitful is their life; everyone honours them. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਹਉਮੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਜਾਤਿ ਹੈ; ਅਤਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
Ego and possessiveness make a person a separate caste, with excessive anger and pride.
ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰੈ. ਤਾ ਜਾਤਿ ਜਾਇ; ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਭਗਵਾਨੁ ॥੨॥
When one dies in the Word, this separateness departs, and one's light merges into the Light of God. ॥2॥
ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿਆ; ਸਫਲ ਜਨਮੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥
Meeting with the perfect True Guru, our life becomes fruitful.
ਨਾਮੁ ਨਵੈ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਇਆ; ਭਰੇ ਅਖੁਟ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
We have obtained the Name, the nine treasures; our storehouses are filled to overflowing, never to run out. ॥3॥
ਆਵਹਿ ਇਸੁ ਰਾਸੀ ਕੇ ਵਾਪਾਰੀਏ; ਜਿਨੑਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥
Those who come as traders in this wealth are those who love the Name.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ. ਸੋ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਏ; ਤਿਨੑਾ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥੪॥
One who becomes Gurmukh obtains this wealth; within such people, the Word and reflection abide. ॥4॥
ਭਗਤੀ ਸਾਰ. ਨ ਜਾਣਨੑੀ; ਮਨਮੁਖ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ ॥
The egotistical self-willed manmukhs do not appreciate the value of devotional worship.
ਧੁਰਹੁ ਆਪਿ ਖੁਆਇਅਨੁ; ਜੂਐ ਬਾਜੀ ਹਾਰੀ ॥੫॥
The Lord Himself has led them astray from the beginning; they lose the game of life, like a gambler. ॥5॥
ਬਿਨੁ ਪਿਆਰੈ. ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ; ਨਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ਸਰੀਰਿ ॥
Without love, there is no devotional worship, nor does the body find peace.
ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਈਐ; ਗੁਰ ਭਗਤੀ ਮਨ ਧੀਰਿ ॥੬॥
The treasure of love is obtained from the Guru; through devotion to the Guru, the mind is steadied. ॥6॥
ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਾਏ. ਸੋ ਕਰੇ; ਗੁਰਸਬਦ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
He alone performs devotional worship whom the Lord inspires to do so, reflecting on the Word of the Guru.
ਹਿਰਦੈ ਏਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ; ਹਉਮੈ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਮਾਰਿ ॥੭॥
The One Name abides in his heart, and he conquers ego and duality. ॥7॥
ਭਗਤਾ ਕੀ ਜਤਿ ਪਤਿ. ਏਕੋੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ; ਆਪੇ ਲਏ ਸਵਾਰਿ ॥
For the devotees, the One Name is their social status and honour; the Lord Himself embellishes them.
ਸਦਾ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ; ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਸਾਰਿ ॥੮॥
They remain forever in His sanctuary; as it pleases Him, He resolves their affairs. ॥8॥
430: ਭਗਤਿ ਨਿਰਾਲੀ ਅਲਾਹ ਦੀ; ਜਾਪੈ ਗੁਰ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
Devotion to God is wondrous; this is realised by reflecting on the Guru's teaching.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਵਸੈ; ਭੈ ਭਗਤੀ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਵਾਰਿ ॥੯॥੧੪॥੩੬॥
O Nanak, one in whose heart the Name abides is embellished by the fear of God, devotion and the Name. ॥9॥14॥36॥
ਅਨ ਰਸ ਮਹਿ ਭੋਲਾਇਆ; ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੈ. ਦੁਖ ਪਾਇ ॥
Lured by other tastes, one goes astray; without the Name, one suffers pain.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ. ਨ ਭੇਟਿਓ; ਜਿ ਸਚੀ ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਇ ॥੧॥
He does not meet the True Guru, the Primal Being, who imparts true understanding. ॥1॥
ਏ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਬਾਵਲੇ; ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਖਿ. ਸਾਦੁ ਪਾਇ ॥
O my crazy mind, taste the sublime essence of the Lord, and savour its flavour.
ਅਨ ਰਸਿ ਲਾਗਾ ਤੂੰ ਫਿਰਹਿ; ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Attached to other tastes, you wander around, wasting your life in vain. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਇਸੁ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖ ਨਿਰਮਲੇ; ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਹਹਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
In this age, the Gurmukhs are pure; they remain attuned to the True Name.
ਵਿਣੁ ਕਰਮਾ. ਕਿਛੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਹੀ; ਕਿਆ ਕਰਿ. ਕਹਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
Without His grace, nothing is obtained; what can anyone say or do? ॥2॥
ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣਹਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰਹਿ; ਮਨਹੁ ਤਜਿ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥
They understand their own selves, and die in the Word, casting corruption out of their minds.
ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਭਜਿ ਪਏ; ਬਖਸੇ ਬਖਸਣਹਾਰ ॥੩॥
They hurry to the Guru's sanctuary, and the Forgiving Lord forgives them. ॥3॥
ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ. ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ; ਨਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
Without the Name, peace is not obtained, nor does pain depart from within.
ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਵਿਆਪਿਆ; ਦੂਜੈ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇ ॥੪॥
This world is engrossed in attachment to Maya; it has gone astray in duality and doubt. ॥4॥
ਦੋਹਾਗਣੀ. ਪਿਰ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ. ਨ ਜਾਣਹੀ; ਕਿਆ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
The unfortunate soul-brides do not appreciate the worth of their Husband Lord; why do they bother to adorn themselves?
ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਜਲਦੀਆ ਫਿਰਹਿ; ਸੇਜੈ ਰਵੈ ਨ. ਭਤਾਰੁ ॥੫॥
Night and day, they wander, forever burning; their Husband Lord does not enjoy them on His bed. ॥5॥
ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
The happy soul-brides obtain the Mansion of His presence, eradicating self-conceit from within.
ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਸੀਗਾਰੀਆ; ਅਪਣੇ ਸਹਿ ਲਈਆ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੬॥
They adorn themselves with the Word of the Guru; their Husband Lord has united them with Himself. ॥6॥
ਮਰਣਾ ਮਨਹੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ; ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ॥
They have forgotten death from their minds; attachment to Maya is pitch darkness.
ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮਹਿ. ਭੀ ਮਰਹਿ; ਜਮ ਦਰਿ ਹੋਹਿ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥੭॥
The self-willed manmukhs die again and again, are reborn, and die once more; they are ruined at the door of death. ॥7॥
ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਅਨੁ ਸੇ ਮਿਲੇ; ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
They alone are united, whom the Lord unites with Himself, through reflection on the Word of the Guru.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਣੇ, ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ; ਤਿਤੁ ਸਚੈ ਦਰਬਾਰਿ ॥੮॥੨੨॥੧੫॥੩੭॥
O Nanak, those absorbed in the Name have radiant faces in that True Court. ॥8॥22॥15॥37॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
I have won over the five virtues, and displeased the five passions.
I have enshrined the five within, and cast out the five. ॥1॥
ਇਨੑ ਬਿਧਿ ਨਗਰੁ ਵੁਠਾ; ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
In this way, the city of my body has become inhabited, O my brother.
ਦੁਰਤੁ ਗਇਆ; ਗੁਰਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Vice has departed, as the Guru has implanted spiritual wisdom within me. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਸਾਚ ਧਰਮ ਕੀ; ਕਰਿ ਦੀਨੀ ਵਾਰਿ ॥
The fence of true Dharma has been built around it.
The gates have been made strong by reflecting on the Guru's spiritual wisdom. ॥2॥
So plant the seed of the Name, O friends, O brothers.
Deal only in this merchandise, and serve the Guru forever. ॥3॥
ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਹਜ; ਸੁਖ ਕੇ ਸਭਿ ਹਾਟ ॥
All the shops become shops of peace, poise and bliss,
where the traders are at one with the Banker. ॥4॥
ਜੇਜੀਆ ਡੰਨੁ; ਕੋ ਲਏ ਨ. ਜਗਾਤਿ ॥
No one levies the jizya tax, a fine or toll on them,
ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੀਨੀ; ਧੁਰ ਕੀ ਛਾਪ ॥੫॥
on whom the True Guru has set the seal of the Primal Lord. ॥5॥
Load the merchandise of the Name, and set out with your cargo.
Earn your profit, and as Gurmukh, return to your own home. ॥6॥
The True Guru is the Banker, and His Sikhs are the traders.
Their capital is the Name, and enshrining the True One within is their account. ॥7॥
ਸੋ ਵਸੈ ਇਤੁ ਘਰਿ; ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਸੇਵ ॥
The Lord dwells in that home, whom the perfect Guru blesses with service.
That heart becomes the eternal, unshakable city of God, O Nanak. ॥8॥1॥
